Opened by warehouse-etl-ken on 2026-10-20

Our Python loader reads the first column of every Ledgerline CSV as `\ufeffDate`
instead of `Date`. A hex viewer shows the bytes EF BB BF at the start of the
file. Is that on purpose

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The CSV exports do prepend a byte order mark (BOM) by default as indicated in the src/export/csv.ts file, specifically in the writeCsv function where a BOM is prefixed unless disabled by options. This is deliberate and assists spreadsheet applications in recognizing UTF-8 encoding. If the BOM remains a stable part of the output, consumers can use the utf-8-sig encoding to handle it properly.
